subject: Life Skills
title: Too Good to Be True Offers
description: One-minute skill: Too Good to Be True Offers.

hook.text: A Nigerian prince promised millions. Decades later, variations of that scam still earn billions.

buildup.text: Scammers exploit hope and greed. Free iPhones, surprise inheritances, and miracle cures all hook victims.

discovery.text: Legitimate offers have clear terms. Scams use vague promises and push you to act immediately.

twist.text: Some scams ask only for a small fee upfront. That tiny payment builds trust before bigger asks.

climax.text: Apply the grandmother test: would you tell your grandma to send money to a stranger online?

quiz.question: What technique do scammers often use first?
options: Asking for a large sum of money
Requesting a small fee to build trust
